Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.2: Raise the total count of the congregation of the sons of Israel, by their clans and their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names — every male according to their heads.
translations.3: From twenty years of age and upward — all who go forth to the hosts of the sons of Israel — you shall count them by their hosts, you and Aaron.
translations.4: And there shall be with you, from each tribe, a man; and that man is the chief of his father's house.
translations.5: And these are the names of the men who shall stand with you: from Reuben — Elizur son of Shedeur;
translations.6: and from Simeon — Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
translations.7: and from Judah — Nahshon son of Amminadab;
translations.8: and from Issachar — Nethanel son of Zuar;
translations.9: and from Zebulun — Eliab son of Helon;
translations.10: and from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim — Elishama son of Ammihud; and from Manasseh — Gamliel son of Pedahzur;
translations.11: and from Benjamin — Abidan son of Gideoni;
translations.12: and from Dan — Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
translations.13: and from Asher — Pagiel son of Ochran;
translations.14: and from Gad — Eliasaph son of Deuel;
translations.15: and from Naphtali — Ahira son of Enan.
translations.16: These are the summoners of the congregation — the nobles of the tribes of their fathers, the heads of the thousands of the sons of Israel.
translations.17: And Moses and Aaron took these men, whose names had been set forth.
translations.18: And they assembled the rest of the congregation on the first day of the second month; and they registered themselves by their clans and their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, according to their heads.
translations.19: As God had commanded Moses — he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.
translations.20: And the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names according to their heads — every male from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.21: those counted accordingly from them — forty-six thousand and five hundred.
translations.22: For the sons of Simeon — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, their number by the enumeration of names according to their heads — every male from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.23: those counted accordingly from them — fifty-nine thousand and three hundred.
translations.24: For the sons of Gad — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.25: those counted accordingly from them — forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty.
translations.26: And the sons of Judah — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.27: those counted accordingly from them — seventy-four thousand and six hundred.
translations.28: And the sons of Issachar — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.29: those counted accordingly from them — fifty-four thousand and four hundred.
translations.30: And the sons of Zebulun — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.31: those counted accordingly from them — fifty-seven thousand and four hundred.
translations.32: For the sons of Joseph, for the sons of Ephraim — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.33: those counted accordingly from them — forty thousand and five hundred.
translations.34: And the sons of Manasseh — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.35: those counted accordingly from them — thirty-six thousand and two hundred.
translations.36: And the sons of Benjamin — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.37: those counted accordingly from them — thirty-five thousand and four hundred.
translations.38: And the sons of Dan — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.39: those counted accordingly from them — sixty-two thousand and seven hundred.
translations.40: And the sons of Asher — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.41: those counted accordingly from them — forty-one thousand and five hundred.
translations.42: The sons of Naphtali — their generations by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the enumeration of names, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts:
translations.43: those counted accordingly from them — fifty-three thousand and four hundred.
translations.44: These are those counted, whom Moses and Aaron and the nobles of the house of Israel counted — twelve men, each one of them the noble of his father's house.
translations.45: And those who were counted from them — traced to their fathers' houses, from twenty years of age and upward, all who go forth in their hosts —
translations.46: the total of those counted was six hundred thousand and three thousand, and five hundred and fifty.
translations.47: But the Levites were not counted among them, by the tribe of their fathers.
translations.48: Then God spoke to Moses directly.
translations.49: 'As for the tribe of Levi — do not count it, and do not raise their total among the sons of Israel.
translations.50: But you — appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and its vessels, and all that belongs to it; they shall carry the tabernacle and all its vessels, and they shall serve it, and around it they shall encamp.
translations.51: And when it sets out, they shall take it apart; and when it encamps, they shall set it up; and any outsider who approaches it shall be put to death.
translations.52: And the sons of Israel shall encamp — each tribe in its encampment and in its position — by their hosts.
translations.53: And the Levites shall encamp around the tabernacle of testimony, so that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the sons of Israel; and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.'
translations.54: And the sons of Israel did according to all that God had commanded Moses — so they did.
